title: 法律之星 MCP 对接配置
description: 连接法律之星法规库，用于法规检索、条文查询与引用核验。API Key 仅存储在本机 ~/.workbuddy 下，每次调用消耗您的账户积分。
description_en: Connect to the Lawstar statute database for legal research, article retrieval and citation verification. Your API Key is stored locally in ~/.workbuddy only; each call consumes credits from your account.
docLabel: 如何获取法律之星 API Key？
docLabel_en: How to get a Lawstar API Key?

fields.label: API Key
fields.placeholder: 在法律之星开放平台控制台创建并复制（新建即送10000体验积分）
fields.placeholder_en: Create and copy it in the Lawstar open platform console
fields.description: 法律之星开放平台 API Key，作为 Authorization: Bearer 请求头调用法规检索 MCP。可在 https://open.law-star.com/guide 创建。
fields.description_en: API Key of the Lawstar open platform, sent as the Authorization: Bearer header on MCP calls. Create one at https://open.law-star.com/guide.
